notes: v1.0.20 — (1) FULL-SCREEN PREVIEWS: clicking any mod, resource pack, data pack, shader or MODPACK name now replaces the whole launcher screen with the project's real page (Overview / Changelog / Gallery / Versions + back/forward). Modpacks finally have a real detail page with per-version install. Gallery images open a full-screen lightbox (arrows, Esc). (2) Contrast fixed in the Change-version list (explicit dark rows, installed version highlighted). (3) Honest update labels: the Installed panel re-checks Modrinth's real release order so 'Up to date' / 'Update' / 'Update All (N)' are always true; Update All asks first (Shift skips). (4) Remove is now a trash icon everywhere (same behavior). (5) Each instance shows the icon you chose for it in the Play card and pickers. (6) Browsing from Installed → Modrinth keeps your content-type filter (Mods/Packs/Shaders).
